g.text: B. Screw coupling interface — nominal datums

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Custom shafts and split bearing bridge required. No custom pulley bore. No unspecified bearing preload.
KSS IGES contains 130 surfaces, no closed solids. Nominal inference assumes shoulder seating on the bearing-pair face.
Journal fits, retainers, surface finish, runout, shaft material/heat treatment, housing alignment and service tooling remain TBD.
CC-BY-NC-4.0 • Odradek / Auromix contributors. Original interface diagram, not manufacturer CAD.
